1.translation: The Hour has drawn near and the moon has split asunder[1].
1.footnotes: [1] The Quraysh pagans challenged the Prophet (ﷺ) to split the moon in two so that they believe in him. The moon was split as they requested and then re-joined, and the incident was reported by several eyewitnesses in different parts of the land; however, they still refused to believe, considering it magic.

2.translation: Whenever they see a sign[2], they turn away and say, “Same old magic!”
2.footnotes: [2] The prophets were given signs or miracles as a proof that they were commissioned by Allah. Moses (عليه السلام) was given the miracles of staff and a bright hand. Jesus (عليه السلام) would give life to the dead and heal the blind and the leper. Muhammad (ﷺ) was given the Qur’an, a literary miracle, challenging the masters of Arabic eloquence. Nonetheless, he (ﷺ) performed other miracles such as splitting the moon, increasing food and water, and healing some ailments.

3.translation: They deny [the truth] and follow their desires, but every matter will reach its inevitable end.

4.translation: There have already come to them stories [of destroyed nations] that are sufficient to deter them,

5.translation: which contain extensive wisdom, but the warnings are of no avail.

6.translation: So turn away from them [O Prophet]. On the Day when the caller[3] will summon them to a horrific event[4],
6.footnotes: [3] Isrāfīl, the angel assigned to blow the Trumpet and call all for resurrection. [4] i.e., Judgment Day.

7.translation: with eyes downcast, they will come out of the graves like scattered locusts,

8.translation: rushing headlong towards the caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a hard Day!”

9.translation: The people of Noah rejected [the truth] before them; they rejected Our slave and said, “He is a madman,” and he was intimidated.

10.translation: So he called upon his Lord, “I am overpowered, so help me!”

11.translation: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,

12.translation: and We caused the earth to burst forth with springs, then the waters met for a preordained purpose.

13.translation: We carried him on an [Ark made] of planks and nails,

14.translation: sailing under Our [Watchful] Eyes; as a reward for the one [they] denied.

15.translation: We have certainly left it[5] as a sign; is there anyone to take heed?
15.footnotes: [5] i.e., the punishment, the Flood, or the Ark.

16.translation: Then how were My punishment and My warnings[6]?
16.footnotes: [6] As a warning to those who came after them.

17.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

18.translation: ‘Ād disbelieved. Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

19.translation: We sent against them a furious wind[7] on a day of continuous misfortune,
19.footnotes: [7] i.e., a tumultuous and screaming wind.

20.translation: sweeping people away[8], as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
20.footnotes: [8] i.e., extracting them from the earth.

21.translation: Then how were My punishment and My warnings?

22.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

24.translation: They said, “Shall we follow a single human being[9] from among us? Then we would surely be in error and insanity!

25.translation: Has the revelation been sent down upon him out of all of us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”

26.translation: Tomorrow they will know who the insolent liar is.

27.translation: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them, so watch them [O Sālih] and be patient,

28.translation: and tell them that the water is to be shared between them[10]; each should take its drink in turn.
28.footnotes: [10] i.e., one day for the tribe of Thamūd and one day for the she-camel.

29.translation: But they called their companion[11], and he undertook the task[12] and hamstrung her.
29.footnotes:
[11] i.e., the worst among them.
 [12] Or took his sword.

30.translation: Then how [terrible] My punishment and My warnings were!

31.translation: We sent against them a single blast, leaving them like trampled hedge-building twigs[13].
31.footnotes: [13] The people of Thamūd were crushed like trampled and trodden twigs and pieces of bush lying around an enclosure for cattle.

32.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

33.translation: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.

34.translation: We sent against them a storm of pebbles, except the family of Lot whom We saved before dawn,

35.translation: as a blessing from Us. Thus do We reward those who give thanks.

36.translation: He had already warned them of Our punishing assault, but they doubted the warnings.

37.translation: They even demanded that he let them have their way with his angel-guests[14], so We blinded their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and My warnings!”
37.footnotes: [14] Whom Allah sent in the form of handsome young men.

38.translation: By the early morning a lasting torment overtook them.

39.translation: Taste My punishment and My warnings!

40.translation: We have certainly made the Qur’an easy to understand and remember; is there anyone to take heed?

41.translation: Indeed, warnings came to the people of Pharaoh.

42.translation: But they rejected all of Our signs, so We seized them with the grip of the All-Mighty, Most Powerful.

43.translation: Are your disbelievers [O Makkans] superior to those[15] or have you been granted immunity in divine Scriptures?

44.translation: Or do they say, “We are a united front, bound to prevail.”?

45.translation: Soon their united front will be defeated, and they will flee[16].
45.footnotes: [16] This foretold event was fulfilled in the Battle of Badr.

46.translation: But the Hour is their appointed time, and the Hour is more catastrophic and more bitter.

47.translation: Indeed, the wicked are in error and blazes[17].
47.footnotes: [17] i.e., will burn in the Hellfire.

48.translation: On the Day when they will be dragged into the Fire on their faces, [they will be told], “Taste the agony of Hell[18]!”
48.footnotes: [18] "Saqar" is one of the names of Hell.

49.translation: We have surely created everything in a determined measure[19].

50.translation: Our command is but a single word[20], which is fulfilled in the blink of an eye.
50.footnotes: [20] Our command when We want something, We only say, "Be," and it is.

51.translation: We have destroyed many like you [O Makkans][21]; is there anyone to take heed?

52.translation: Everything they did is in the written records,

53.translation: and everything, small or big, is written down.

54.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and rivers[22],
54.footnotes: [22] Rivers of water, honey, milk, and wine. See 47:15.

55.translation: seated in honor in the presence of the Most Powerful Sovereign.
